property_summary: For every caller address, when the current owner (initial owner after initialize) calls updateRoundImplementation with a non-zero address, the reference contract will successfully set roundImplementation to that address; the mutant (which requires owner() == address(0)) prevents the real owner from succeeding and thus for some fuzzed caller/address inputs the stored roundImplementation differs.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner to check caller equals zero address, effectively preventing owner from calling guarded functions and allowing others (including zero address) to pass; this can alter who may call updateRoundImplementation and thus change roundImplementation observable value.
